description: Build integration test for aidr_commit_gateway.py verdict-check enforcement. Phase 9. Test MUST verify: (1) gateway refuses CAUTION_LIMITED or HIGH_RISK_ISOLATED verdicts, (2) gateway accepts TRUSTED_* and ENTERPRISE_CONTROLLED, (3) injection_resilience score is included in commit payload, (4) explicit override path works for CAUTION_LIMITED with documented reason. Uses synthetic verdict data. Does NOT make real AiDr API calls. Logs test results to service_health.
